description: Add members and teams to an on-call policy the project has, as the on-call guided setup's "Who else is on call?" does: to one of its levels (level 1, paged at once, by default), or as a new level after its last, paged when nobody acknowledges within afterMinutes, which then sets how long the level before it waits. Someone a level pages already is left as they are: a second identical call adds nobody and makes no second level. Someone invited to the project who has not joined yet is added by the address they were invited at: they are paged once they join, and nothing reaches them before. In a project that pages nobody yet, use set_up_paging. Acts as the person signed in (OAuth), with their permissions; an API key cannot.

afterMinutes.description: For a new level: minutes the level before waits for an acknowledgement, 1 to 1440. Defaults to 30.

alsoPage.description: Members to add, by name or email, and people invited who have not joined yet, by the address they were invited at.

includeMe.description: Add the person signed in too. Defaults to false.

level.description: The level to add to: 1, the first, by default. One past the last makes a new level.

policy.description: The policy, by name. Leave it out only when the project has one.

name: add_to_on_call_policy
title: Add To On-Call Policy
